rules: Spacing and layout come from MudBlazor: MudStack (Spacing), MudGrid and its utility classes (pa-4, mt-2, gap-4, d-flex, justify-space-between, align-center), which step by 4 px. Use them in Class="…" rather than padding or margin in the stylesheet.

MudBlazor draws buttons and some labels in capitals by default (MudButton is text-transform: uppercase). The design's text must show exactly as designed: when it is not capitals, keep the case with Style="text-transform: none" on that component.

MudCheckBox and the other selection controls fill the width of their parent unless told otherwise: put one in a MudStack Row="true" or give it Class="d-inline-flex" when the design's control is only as wide as its label.
